title: European Respiratory Society statement on novel nicotine and tobacco products, their role in tobacco control and “harm reduction”
abstract: Extract A growing number of new tobacco and nicotine products have emerged in recent years and are especially popular among adolescents and young adults. These are collectively known as “novel and emerging nicotine and tobacco products” [1, 2], and include electronic cigarettes, heated tobacco products and nicotine pouches. Tweetable abstract The ERS Tobacco Control Committee finds lack of evidence supporting the tobacco industry's “harm reduction” claims. All nicotine products remain harmful and addictive. It is vital to reduce tobacco use and protect youth from addiction to novel products. https://bit.ly/3Ovm98C
